title: Any framework (runner protocol) · zkworld
description: The Any framework (runner protocol) framework as a running submod of zkworld: its toolchain, starters and every Any framework (runner protocol) project here. Bring any ZK toolchain: the project's config.json `zk` block names its build/test/run commands, and its runner speaks the two-call protocol (--abi, <input.json>). zkVMs and libraries plug in here.
